stories.title: ASU hockey coach put on leave after player collapsed during workout

en.title: ASU hockey coach put on leave after player collapsed during workout
en.summary: An Arizona State University hockey coach was placed on leave after a 21-year-old player collapsed during a workout in August and was hospitalized.

stories.title: Cornell agrees to outside review of how it handled alleged sexual assault: Governor

en.title: Cornell agrees to outside review of how it handled alleged sexual assault: Governor
en.summary: New York's governor requested an independent review of Cornell University's handling of an alleged sexual assault case, citing concerns about the institution's campus culture.

stories.title: Federal Reserve renovations criticized by Trump did not violate laws, watchdog finds

en.title: Federal Reserve renovations criticized by Trump did not violate laws, watchdog finds
en.summary: A watchdog investigation determined that Federal Reserve renovation cost overruns did not break federal law, though it found poor project management was responsible for significant cost increases.

stories.title: Senator Marsha Blackburn Sues Over Jack Smith’s Subpoena During Trump Inquiry

en.title: Senator Marsha Blackburn Sues Over Jack Smith's Subpoena During Trump Inquiry
en.summary: Tennessee Senator Marsha Blackburn filed a lawsuit challenging a subpoena issued during the Trump inquiry, raising constitutional questions about congressional immunity protections.

stories.title: Watchdog finds Fed mishandled renovations that Trump tried to oust Powell over

en.title: Watchdog finds Fed mishandled renovations that Trump tried to oust Powell over
en.summary: The Federal Reserve's inspector general identified cost overruns in building renovations but found no criminal violations. The Justice Department had previously closed its investigation into the project.

stories.title: Fed’s Watchdog Finds No Misconduct or Illegal Activity in Costly Renovations

en.title: Fed's Watchdog Finds No Misconduct or Illegal Activity in Costly Renovations
en.summary: The Federal Reserve's independent inspector general determined a $2.5 billion construction project was poorly managed but contained no illegal activity and made no referrals for prosecution.

stories.title: Democrats Block Stock-Trading Bill, Denying the G.O.P. a Pre-Midterm Win

en.title: Democrats Block Stock-Trading Bill, Denying the G.O.P. a Pre-Midterm Win
en.summary: Senate Democrats prevented passage of a Republican bill that would have limited congressional stock trading. The measure had been proposed as part of Republican efforts to address voter concerns.

stories.title: Senate Democrats block Husted-led bill on data centers, calling it ‘toothless’

en.title: Senate Democrats block Husted-led bill on data centers, calling it 'toothless'
en.summary: Democrats blocked a bill designed to prevent data centers from raising local utility costs, despite its lopsided House passage. Republicans characterized the Democratic action as political obstruction.

stories.title: Latest on FlyDubai flight to Israel where passenger says "co-pilot tried to murder pilot"

en.title: Latest on FlyDubai flight to Israel where passenger says "co-pilot tried to murder pilot"
en.summary: A FlyDubai aircraft from Dubai to Israel made an emergency landing after a pilot attempted to violently seize control and crash the plane, according to passengers and Israeli officials.

stories.title: Senate Democrats block bill to limit lawmakers' stock trades

en.title: Senate Democrats block bill to limit lawmakers' stock trades
en.summary: Senate Democrats rejected a Republican-backed measure on restricting legislators' stock trading that had passed the House, citing insufficient restrictions and opposing a voter identification component.

stories.title: Ex-special counsel Jack Smith tells lawmakers 'I stand by' decisions to charge Trump

en.title: Ex-special counsel Jack Smith tells lawmakers 'I stand by' decisions to charge Trump
en.summary: Former special counsel Jack Smith testified before the Senate Judiciary Committee, defending his two criminal investigations into President Donald Trump.

stories.title: Jack Smith clashes with senators over Trump probes, says he will not be silenced

en.title: Jack Smith clashes with senators over Trump probes, says he will not be silenced
en.summary: Former special counsel Jack Smith testified before lawmakers defending his efforts to prosecute Trump, stating he will not be deterred by threats of prosecution from the president.

en.title: A Tech-Fueled Stock Market Powers Through, but Limps Into the Fourth Quarter
en.summary: The Nasdaq composite and S&P 500 are tracking toward double-digit annual gains for the fourth consecutive year, though rising interest rates could affect performance moving forward.

en.title: WSJ Dollar Index Falls 0.50% This Quarter to 97.04
en.summary: The WSJ Dollar Index increased 0.1% and rose for three consecutive trading days during the period.

stories.title: MSG Sports Board Approves Spin-Off of Rangers From Knicks

en.title: MSG Sports Board Approves Spin-Off of Rangers From Knicks
en.summary: MSG Sports' board has approved separating the Knicks and Rangers into two independent companies that will each trade on the New York Stock Exchange.

stories.title: Natural Gas Closes Out Negative Third Quarter

en.title: Natural Gas Closes Out Negative Third Quarter
en.summary: Natural gas futures declined 7.6% over the third quarter to settle at $3.026 per million British thermal units, though prices rose 0.5% on the final day.

en.title: Surging Yields Bring the Bond Market Back to the Turn of the Century
en.summary: The 10-year Treasury yield has climbed above 5.3%, reaching its highest level in 24 years.
